facts.text: Melanie celebrated her daughter's birthday with a concert featuring Matt Patterson, who is described as talented with amazing voice and songs.

evidence.quote: We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze.
It was Matt Patterson, he is so talented! His voice and songs were amazing.

facts.text: Caroline attended a pride parade last Friday, which she described as an event with a lot of energy and love, making her proud and reminding her of the importance of standing up for equality.

evidence.quote: I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.

facts.text: Caroline expressed that the pride parade inspired her to continue fighting for LGBTQ rights, and she shared a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons.

evidence.quote: It really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
